info.description: Rich-text content, optionally paired with one or more images, for a position within a Section's Blocks zone. Replaces the old fixed `content` field on Section — a section can now carry several of these, interleaved with video/interactive/embed blocks in whatever order editors arrange them.

heading.description: Optional heading shown above this block's text.

content.description: Body text. studio-vr renders each top-level block as a paragraph, same as Section's old `content` field did.

images.description: Zero or more images shown alongside the text, uploaded via the S3 provider.

imagePosition.description: Where the image(s) sit relative to the text. "text-only" hides images even if some are attached, letting this block double as a plain text block.
